instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORT FONTS FIRST: Add the Google Fonts link to public/index.html or @import in index.css.
FORCE DARK MODE: The app must default to dark mode. No light mode toggle needed for this persona.
USE GRID LAYOUTS: Dashboard pages must use the 'Bento' grid system defined in layout.grid_system.
NO ROUNDED CORNERS: Use 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none' for a sharp, tactical look. Avoid 'rounded-xl'.
DATA DENSITY: Do not use excessive padding. This is a pro tool. Use 'p-4' or 'p-5' for cards.
ALWAYS USE CUSTOM SCROLLBAR: Hide default browser scrollbar, use a thin styled one.
FORBIDDEN: Do not use purple, pink, or gradients unless it's a 'Heatmap'. Stick to Red/Black/Grey/Green.
TESTING: Add data-testid to all inputs, buttons, and result cards.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index, borders).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Use 2-3x more spacing in marketing sections, but keep dashboard sections dense.
Prioritize Shadcn components but customize them to match the 'Cyber Tactical' aesthetic (remove radius, change ring color).
